summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed a Form 8-K with Items 8.01 and 9.01 on August 18, 2026, to furnish a press release announcing that its subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices received a fifth-unit ROSA order from a property management client, bringing that client's total to nine units. The filing is a routine business update and press release furnishing, containing no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or strategic changes. It is a standard operational announcement with no financial terms or board actions. No special situation; treat as routine current report.
